note: Round 42 runtime fixes: OpenApi::merge no longer adds an empty tags array when neither side had tags; vespera::cron::start_once leaves its Once unset when the start fails, so a later call retries (as start_once_for_crate does); the DIRECT stash counts an entry a fetch has taken out toward its ceilings until it is put back, so concurrent fresh stashes cannot push the stash past the hard limits.
